summary: Security lens of the story pass. The classification preserves every integrity boundary: evidence and canon reads are STRICT utf-8 (corruption refuses instead of silently mangling — 0009/0025), byte-exact digest and measurement paths are untouched and allowlisted by name, git path output uses surrogateescape so hostile or unusual filenames cannot crash gates or collapse into each other, and errors='replace' is confined to human diagnostics where the worst outcome is a '?' in a log. Spawned workers get PYTHONUTF8=1 — an env addition, no new trust. The hygiene gate itself is a read-only AST walk with no execution of scanned code.

non_blocking_findings.summary: isolation scan's replace-decode keeps marker detection on undecodable sources — the review caught that skip would have opened a smuggling hole; replace closes it without lossy evidence decoding

residual_risks: D-0026: workflow-inline Python stays locale-default on GH's UTF-8-friendly runners; revisit trigger recorded
